{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Ill Wind''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Ill Wind''{{'s}} navigator, [[Monnda Tebbo]] prevented the ship from crashing when it was attacked by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces over [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]]. This incident prompted the ship's entire crew to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|83|Ill Wind (1)}}</ref>
